title: Raw readings not showing after switching to Libre Bluetooth from Patched Libre App
body:
I've been using xDrip+ Nightly builds and I was previously using patched Libre app as a data source, back then raw readings were showing up nicely. And I really found them useful at picking up trend changes much faster than the averaged values that update at most every five minutes. It also helps with determining the right moment for calibration as it is easy to determine how well the reading has stabilized.

However, I lost all raw readings from the graph as I switched to Libre Bluetooth and OOP2. I did the switch in middle of active sensor, simply by changing the data source from patched app to Libre Bluetooth. I did not stop the current sensor. As soon as I did the first NFC scan, all raw readings vanished immediately through out the entire history I had. That would be fine if new data would be showing up, but I just can't figure out how to enable it as the actual setting that should do it doesn't make any difference.

Judging from the behavior how the raw readings got lost, I think this is probably a bug in xDrip+ itself and perhaps some conflict in the data or settings I have. Probably I didn't quite do the switch the way I should have done it. I'm open to any suggestions how I should debug this issue and hopefully prevent anyone else seeing this same.

Right now I'm using Nightly build c98a3c4-2021.10.17 or 2110171607. I've been updating xDrip+ manually every now and then, at least once every two months or so.

Thanks in advance, xDrip+ has really been a game changer in how I monitor my glucose levels. I really appreciate all of the features it has.
